recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core edit is needed unless these workflow extension definitions move back into core or a later issue changes their intended contexts; no Extension Pack follow-up is indicated because the relevant contexts are already present there.
issue_request: FHIR-27879 was a Published FHIR-core/Public Health change request, raised against R4 and applied for R5, asking how ImmunizationEvaluation should identify the protocol used for an evaluation. Its Not Persuasive with Modification resolution selected adding ImmunizationEvaluation as context for workflow-adheresTo and workflow-generatedFrom instead of adding instantiatedCanonical/instantiatedURI elements.
initial_application: Core commit e4ec3c0aee74abe0018e5bc2080eed7663ffd430, merged by 77fdb9999044b49afffef3ac1498e7f84c6e1927, added ImmunizationEvaluation to the generatedFrom and adheresTo rows in source/profiles/workflow-extensions-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-27016 added instantiatesCanonical/instantiatesUri to Immunization and ImmunizationRecommendation while explicitly deferring ImmunizationEvaluation. FHIR-32392 later removed those R5 instantiates elements in favor of standard workflow extensions. PHWG minutes on 2022-08-18 approved FHIR-27879's adheresTo/generatedFrom proposal 28-0-0, and the Zulip workflow thread records Lloyd McKenzie agreeing that those extensions made sense. Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 subsequently removed the workflow extension definitions from the R5 core source, and the current Extension Pack source contains the authoritative StructureDefinitions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core checkout no longer owns the workflow-adheresTo or workflow-generatedFrom StructureDefinitions, and the read-only Extension Pack checkout already contains ImmunizationEvaluation as a context for both extensions.
